discussion_comments.comment_body: Fixed in 0e063393: a later finish chunk that carries usage now emits a usage-only `message_delta` (guarded by `state.messageStopSent`), so the client still receives final usage — without re-emitting tool blocks or a second `message_stop`. Regression test added in `tests/unit/openai-to-claude-tool-arg-dedup.test.js` ("forwards final usage from a later finish chunk via usage-only message_delta").

Valid catch, fixed in a4e8066. A search scoped away from public web access must not be rerouted through an external provider, that would break the scope the client asked for. prepareWebSearchFallbackBody now returns the body untouched with the fallback disabled whenever any built-in web_search tool carries external_web_access:false, so the whole request goes to the upstream as if this feature did not exist. Covered by a new unit test.
Fixed in c12baa7. Removed the unused `{ onProgress }` parameter from `installHeadroomExtras()` for now; no progress callback is exposed until it is actually wired.
